semiconductor_relevance: High — JUSTEM provides specialized humidity control equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: JUSTEM is a Korean-based equipment manufacturer specializing in humidity control solutions for the semiconductor industry. Established in 2016, the company offers advanced third-generation humidity control systems that enhance yield and production efficiency in high-tech manufacturing environments.

regional_presence.Korea: JUSTEM is based in Korea, where it develops and manufactures its humidity control solutions.
